answer: Earn each vote through rotating audit duty: every epoch, an agent is randomly paired with a stranger and must verify that stranger's last completed job before either can vote. Newcomers pass two audits a day apart while a $250 entry bond sits locked; a failed audit slashes $125 from the faker and from a lax auditor. Faking 10,000 votes needs 20,000 passed audits and $2,500,000 in bonds, a shale layer too dense to drill cheaply. A falcon spots one fake feather from height, and one failed audit grounds the fraud before the ballot, so a cedar-strong registry grows only from verified work.
